problems.detail: V1 is fixed for an honestly-labelled bomb, but officeZipWithinLimits trusts the uncompressed sizes declared in the central directory and JSZip inflates the whole entry before its size-mismatch check. Probe: a DOCX whose central directory declares 1000 bytes for word/document.xml passes the guard; 60 KB -> 60 MB inflated (+95 MB RSS), 398 KB -> 400 MB (+457 MB RSS), both end as 'broken'; a 1.2 MB file crashed a node process with a 1 GB heap during planPrintFiles (FATAL heap out of memory). The 25 MB upload limit allows far larger. Rated minor for this task because the identical weakness already exists on master in the knowledge preview route (same guard, same JSZip call, reachable by the same managers with the same file), so this change reaches parity with the existing protection, which is what round 1 asked for. It is still a cross-tenant DoS vector in the shared helper.
problems.suggestion: Add one bounded extractor and use it in docxText and the preview route: inflate word/document.xml with a hard output cap (e.g. zip.file(...).internalStream('uint8array') counting bytes and pausing/rejecting past ~20 MB, or zlib.inflateRawSync(compressed, { maxOutputLength: 20 MB })).

problems.detail: The V7(b) decision says read-only viewers 'видят список и номера без кнопок', but keys = canManage ? … : [] means no revision states are requested, so RevisionControl renders nothing. head_chef/technologist (management, no admin.full) open app 6 and see the list without any revision number. Р5 says everyone sees the number, and the GET states API only needs PPK access, which these users have.
problems.suggestion: Always build keys from docs; keep canApprove={canManage}.

problems.detail: jsPDF addImage without a compression argument stores the decoded pixels. One 600x200 RGBA canvas signature (about 2 KB as PNG) adds about 350 KB to the PDF. Measured: 294 KB with no signatures, 646 KB with one, 7.36 MB with 20. With a staff of 100 the employee file, the inspector link and the compliance bundle get a PDF of about 35 MB.
problems.suggestion: ctx.doc.addImage(dataUrl, 'PNG', x, y, w, h, undefined, 'FAST'), or flatten the signature to greyscale before embedding.

problems.detail: The new 'Редакция ППК NNN от …' line can label content that was never approved. For 'team-regulation' the page body is the generic template (teamRegulationSections), while the revision belongs to item 2.2's saved text or scan. For 'policy' with an uploaded scan, the hash covers the scans, yet the page shows the policy text, which may have been edited after approval.
problems.suggestion: Show the line only when the page shows the hashed content (knowledge docs; policy without scans). Otherwise link to the approved scan or leave the line out.

problems.detail: Performance. Every state lookup has Postgres read and sha256 the full content of each file, and it loads the content of text docs. This runs on every /knowledge mount and every ppk:changed event (all docs, in chunks of 60), on every text and policy panel render, on every acknowledgement page, and on every PPK print (up to 300 docs). Large knowledge bases (hundreds of documents of several MB) make each view or print read gigabytes.
problems.suggestion: Cache hashes in process memory keyed by (id, updatedAt, sizeBytes), or hash only documents that have a revision.

problems.detail: V4 is only partly fixed. Text docs are always read now. But formats that print only as a line (ZIP, RAR, 7Z, XLS, XLSX, DOC) and DOCX still consume the 80 MB byte budget and are read into memory. A later PDF or image scan can then print 'не вставлен: в программе уже много страниц сканов' even though the scans total under 80 MB, while Р7 limits only the scans.
problems.suggestion: Do not load bytes for formats printed as a line, and count only PDF and images against SCAN_MAX_BYTES (DOCX bounded separately).

problems.detail: Nit. Every employee /acknowledge page (Mini App included) and /knowledge now ships the whole productionControl namespace, about 72 KB of JSON, to the client. They use about 0.2 KB of signature and revision strings from it.
problems.suggestion: Move the strings the client needs (signature, revisions, textDocs) into a small namespace or into 'acknowledge'.

problems.detail: Nit. A point-scoped register hides other points' procedures only while they still exist. Once a procedure is deleted its row is no longer found, so its title and approver show up for managers of every point.
problems.suggestion: For point-scoped users, also drop knowledge rows whose document no longer exists, or store the building in the docKey or the revision row for procedures.
